title: [cosmeticIssue] [3.0.0.1-e] wear watchface "digital" - minutes are a little bit moved down as hour
body:
Hi community!

as initially creator of "digital" watchface, I has positioned the top corner of hour and minutes on a line. After some improvement and optimization the minutes are moved a little bit down.

Please realign the minutes, how shown in watchface preview picture (when you open the  watchface-selector-menu).

Additionally hint: use 24hour clock, so AM/PM is hidden.

Priority: low
